name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement quantum phase estimation in Qiskit
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement quantum phase estimation in Qiskit with 5 counting qubits to estimate the phase of the eigenvalue exp(2*pi*i*0.28125) of a phase gate. Print the estimated phase and the error. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
